Ava (Content): quick draft up — two hero directions + single-line benchmark. need fast ok from design, legal, and routing.

Ava (Content): HERO 1: 'Ship LLM features faster with predictable latency'
HERO 2: 'Reduce inference cost while keeping SLA-level performance'
Bench blurb: 'In internal benchmarks, Redwood saw up to 3x lower median latency on long-context requests.'

Jules (Growth): both readwell. want to A/B hero + CTA.

Priya (Demand): routing mapping: `Request demo` -> SDR queue; `See benchmarks` -> benchmarks nurture; `Join waitlist` -> waitlist list. will confirm exact HubSpot names.

Noah (Design): comps ready. will swap assets after final copy lock. figma: https://figma.com/file/uniquelink

Liam (Ops): note demo capacity first 2 weeks limited. recommend calendar gating: NA/EMEA bookable, APAC -> waitlist. add 60s form throttle.

Sam (Product): Rosa, legal — can you vet the "up to 3x" phrasing? if needed prefer: 'In our internal benchmarks, Redwood observed up to 3x lower median latency; results vary by model.'

Rosa (Legal): that wording is fine. please include the qualifier line in the benchmarks section (not hero).

Ava (Content): locking hero to short line for design: 'Up to 3x lower median latency on long-context requests.' subhead: 'Ship reliable LLM features with better unit economics.' CTAs: primary `Request demo`, secondary `See benchmarks`.
